description: This file defines a FavoritesController class for managing favorite articles in an ASP.NET Core application. It contains two endpoints: one for adding an article to favorites and one for removing it, utilizing MediatR for command handling.

classes.name: FavoritesController
classes.description: Controller handling favorite article actions with endpoints to add or remove favorites, using MediatR to send commands.

methods.name: FavoriteAdd
methods.description: Handles POST request to favorite an article identified by slug.

methods.name: FavoriteDelete
methods.description: Handles DELETE request to unfavorite an article identified by slug.
